· Significantly below SMA100 (243,681 KRW) and SMA200 (238,276 KRW): long-term trend weak

· Swing Resistance (209,000 KRW): higher than 5-day high (199,950 KRW), potential for short-term rebound if broken
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Consolidation): no clear Higher Low or Lower High formed
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.80): subdued compared to 5-day average, reduced confidence in price movement
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation): searching for direction, entry conditions for buy/sell not met
